svg.title: W1-03 Two Endings: Arrival or Open (instructor)
svg.desc: The same rising path C4 D4 E4 F4 G4 A4 B4, one note per beat. Ending A stops on B4 and leaves two beats of silence. Ending B continues to C5 and holds it for two beats. C5 is an octave above home C4.

g.text: Ending A: stop on B4, then silence
Ending B: continue to C5 and hold
B4 to C5 is 1 semitone. C5 (MIDI 72) is one octave, 12 semitones, above home C4 (MIDI 60).

svg.text: Listen to both. How does each ending leave you feeling? Your answer is yours.
Original AMF graphic, rendered from data (no AI-drawn notation). C4 = MIDI 60.
